description: End-to-end test suite for booking functionalities in a web application using Playwright, covering various booking scenarios including team events, user events, round robin hosts rotation, and invitation flows.

methods.name: getOrgOrigin
methods.description: Constructs the organization URL based on the orgSlug, replacing parts of WEBAPP_URL.

methods.name: bookUserEvent
methods.description: Automates booking a user event, verifying booking success and attendee list.

methods.name: markPhoneNumberAsRequiredAndEmailAsOptional
methods.description: Configures event type settings to make phone number required and email optional.

methods.name: markPhoneNumberAsRequiredField
methods.description: Sets the attendee phone number field as required in event type settings.
